blocks.text: Updated Wed Feb 11 after the Ducal Freight discovery call. Changes from draft 1: Ducal requirements added, sync moved from nightly batch to events, field versioning section added.
Let Balcony App inspections flow into Montague's Mesh Routing in a shared format, with Ducal Freight as the pilot customer.
Offline sync: inspectors work offline in the yard; inspections sync on their own when the tablet reconnects. No manual resend.
Signed PDF: one signed PDF per inspection (inspector signature + time). Auditors need it within 24 hours.
Export by site: inspections land in Ducal's freight system grouped by site (30 sites).
Ducal sees only the data Ducal sends. No access to Montague routing data.
Was: nightly batch, Balcony to Mesh Routing.

Now: events. Each inspection is sent as an event when it is signed. Events go into a local queue on the device first, so Balcony keeps working when Mesh Routing is down or the tablet is offline. The queue drains when the connection comes back.
Who can change fields in the inspection record, and how both sides find out.
Who owns field versioning? (talk to Romeo at 3)
